optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Search Quality Analyst, Knowledge Search Product
professionalSummary: Search quality analyst with three years of experience on a knowledge search product, measuring search quality through the relevance judgement programme under the team's measurement standard.
Analysed query logs weekly, prepared and filed weekly quality reports for the search product manager.
Proposed nineteen ranking rule changes with expected effects, each approved or declined by the search product manager.
Coordinated judgement batches with six relevance judges, recording batch design ownership.
Authored limitation sections and hand‑over conditions for each ranking rule proposal for ranking engineers.
experienceHighlights: Measured search quality via relevance judgement programme under team standards.
Weekly analysis of query logs and preparation of quality reports.
Proposed and documented nineteen ranking rule changes with expected effects and approval records.
Coordinated judgement batches with relevance judges, documenting ownership boundaries.
Documented limitations and hand‑over conditions for ranking rule proposals.
projectsAndWorkSamples: One weekly quality report, two ranking rule proposals with decision records, and one judgement batch design, all referenced in the search quality folder.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample sources establish the candidate’s experience and activities related to search quality measurement, query log analysis, ranking rule proposal, batch coordination, and documentation. They do not provide evidence of the candidate’s interaction with ranking engineers beyond documentation, nor do they confirm the candidate’s direct approval authority over ranking changes.

evidence.text: Search quality analyst on a knowledge search product for three years, measuring search quality through the relevance judgement programme under the team's measurement standard with monthly judgement batches.
Analysed the query logs for failure patterns each week and prepared the weekly quality report for the search product manager, with the reports filed in the search quality folder.

evidence.text: Proposed nineteen ranking rule changes with their expected effect on the quality metrics; each was approved or declined by the search product manager, recorded on the proposal.

evidence.text: Coordinated the judgement batches with the six relevance judges through the batch schedule, recording which batch designs were mine and which followed the standard templates.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of coordination and responsibility boundaries

evidence.text: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each ranking rule proposal for the ranking engineers.
